QuestInfo.name: Qualifier 2: Ludibrium
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Stalinko to start your second qualifying mission for the Tournament of Heroes.
QuestInfo.1:
Hunt 150 #b#o3000005##k monsters near Korean Folk Town for your second mission.
Then, use #b#t2432252##k to return to the Tournament area.

(If you need to restart, forfeit the quest and begin from the very beginning.)
QuestInfo.2: You passed the mission. On to the next!

1.0: You slammed the second mission HARD!\r\nAre you ready to take on the third and final mission? Talk to me again and we'll get this show on the road!

mob.0: You still need to take down 150 Brown Teddies.\r\nIf you need to start over, forfeit the quest first. Then we can talk do-overs.
